svg.title: Reduce AI Cost Without Losing Correctness
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-cache-and-routing-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Reduce AI Cost Without Losing Correctness; subtitle: Preserve reusable input, expire changing answers, evaluate routing, and inspect the actual operating result.; caption: IBM Technology, Mastra, Learn with Vichu, AmanAI Lab, Hunter Sneed, and Morning Maker Show with Sandra and Dan describe the checks behind cost optimization.; assumptions note: Mastra's 90% cached-input discount is not a whole-bill reduction. Hunter Sneed's roughly 50% saving belongs to an eight-task demonstration, not every routed workload.; note: Hunter Sneed includes routing costs and observes variable tier selection on borderline requests. Sandra on Morning Maker Show reports a launch-morning functionality failure that could otherwise be mistaken for weak demand.; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Does the reusable prompt prefix stay identical?; pass next: G2; fail action: Follow Mastra by moving changing memory after stable knowledge. Follow Learn with Vichu by keeping tool names, order, schemas, and JSON ordering stable.; gate: G2; question: Can a cached answer remain valid until it expires?; pass next: G3; fail action: Follow AmanAI Lab by checking expiration for changing answers rather than retaining stale balances indefinitely.; gate: G3; question: Do routed outputs meet quality needs after classifier and retry costs are included?; pass next: G4; fail action: Re-evaluate model choices and borderline requests as Hunter Sneed recommends; attribute usage by user, tenant, workload, or department.; gate: G4; question: Do memory behavior, core functionality, and checkout survive the change?; pass next: Monitor attributable spending and retained usage, following Hunter Sneed and The Startup Podcast.; fail action: Benchmark memory behavior as IBM Technology recommends and repair functionality before interpreting missing sales, as Sandra's launch experience illustrates.

text.title: Reduce AI Cost Without Losing Correctness
text.tspan: Reduce AI Cost Without Losing Correctness

circle.title: gate: G1; question: Does the reusable prompt prefix stay identical?; pass next: G2; fail action: Follow Mastra by moving changing memory after stable knowledge. Follow Learn with Vichu by keeping tool names, order, schemas, and JSON ordering stable.

gate: G2; question: Can a cached answer remain valid until it expires?; pass next: G3; fail action: Follow AmanAI Lab by checking expiration for changing answers rather than retaining stale balances indefinitely.

gate: G3; question: Do routed outputs meet quality needs after classifier and retry costs are included?; pass next: G4; fail action: Re-evaluate model choices and borderline requests as Hunter Sneed recommends; attribute usage by user, tenant, workload, or department.

gate: G4; question: Do memory behavior, core functionality, and checkout survive the change?; pass next: Monitor attributable spending and retained usage, following Hunter Sneed and The Startup Podcast.; fail action: Benchmark memory behavior as IBM Technology recommends and repair functionality before interpreting missing sales, as Sandra's launch experience illustrates.

text.title: Assumptions: Mastra's 90% cached-input discount is not a whole-bill reduction. Hunter Sneed's roughly 50% saving belongs to an eight-task demonstration, not every routed workload.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Mastra's 90% cached-input discount is not a whole-bill reduction. Hunter Sneed's roughly 50% saving belongs to an eight-
